scenes.name: 529 TRIANGLES
lines: The nineteen-point shell spans five hundred twenty-nine triangles, each carrying a loop angle built from two clock phases.
十九点球壳张成 529 个三角面，每个面都带着一个由两只钟的相位围出的回路角。
In this model, each triangle pays one minus cosine of k times its angle, for each winding k.
在这个模型里，对每个绕数 k，每个三角面付出 1 减去 k 倍回路角的余弦。
Higher windings are sharper harmonics, carving narrow pockets the first harmonic cannot.
绕数越高，谐波越尖锐：它们能凿出基频凿不出的狭窄势阱。

scenes.name: ORDER MATTERS
lines: Why can a triangle feel orientation? Because rotations do not commute; otherwise loop phases would just add.
三角面凭什么分得出取向？因为旋转不可交换；否则回路相位只会简单相加。
One plus i times one plus j gives one, one, one, one. Reverse them, and the last entry flips.
1+i 乘 1+j 得 (1, 1, 1, 1)；把次序倒过来，最后一个分量就变号。
Lean checks they lie on different rays, and that the orthogonal half-step triad has Gram determinant exactly one quarter.
Lean 检验：二者不在同一射线上；正交半步三元组的格拉姆行列式恰为 1/4。

scenes.name: THE WALL
lines: Up to eighteen, nothing: the slope inside the windows always stays above three.
直到 18 圈，什么也没有：三窗之内，梯度处处大于 3。
At nineteen, the first stationary point appears, a saddle. At twenty-one, the first strict local minimum.
19 圈首现驻点，是个鞍点；21 圈首现严格局部极小。
At twenty-seven the global minimum enters the windows, but the flavor readings collapse to under a third of reference.
27 圈时全局最低点终于落进三窗，可两项味读数跌到参考值的三分之一以下。

scenes.name: ONE HUNDRED FIVE
lines: Demand the reference flavor too, and the ladder climbs: the first such local minimum sits at thirty-one.
再要求参考味，阶梯就继续往上爬：兼顾参考味的局部极小首现于 31 圈。
At thirty-six, a global flavor vacuum exists, if the weights may change with height.
36 圈时，只要权重允许随高度调整，兼顾参考味的全局真空就存在。
One fixed set of weights for every height needs exactly one hundred five windings, and leaves one hundred coefficients free.
一套权重通吃全部高度，恰好需要 105 圈，而且仍留下 100 个自由系数。

scenes.name: NO DAMPING
lines: Could decaying weights work instead? Interval certificates say no: a native shell competitor beats every such vacuum by over one quarter.
权重能不能随圈数衰减？区间证书说不能：原生竞争点总比这类味真空低出 1/4 以上。
Ten binary digits of the flavor coordinate already exclude them all. With nine digits, a counterexample appears.
六面味坐标只记十位二进制就足以全数排除；退到九位，反例立刻出现。

scenes.name: THE FLAGSHIP ZERO
lines: Now take one real Riemann zero, the one whose number fills the screen.
现在看一枚真实的黎曼零点，就是屏幕上这个编号。
Its own clocks pass all three windows, with an action under five times ten to the minus eight above the vacuum.
仅凭它自己的两只钟就通过三窗，作用量只比真空高出不到 5×10⁻⁸。
Both flavor readings land within one and a half parts per million of reference.
两项味读数与参考值的偏差都在百万分之一点五以内。
Such zeros have positive density. Yet this is a witness inside the model, not a derivation of quark mixing.
这样的零点具有正密度。但这是模型内部的见证，不是对夸克混合的推导。

scenes.name: FOUR CRACKS
lines: Stress tests on this very zero show cracks. Near the vacuum, weights two billionths apart differ by under ten to the minus seventy-four.
压力测试露出裂隙：真空附近相差 2×10⁻⁹ 的权重，作用差不到 10⁻⁷⁴。
Charge one's light modes leak over thirty-one percent into heavy states of charges two and minus four.
荷 1 的三轻模，有三成一以上泄入荷 2 与荷 −4 的重态。
One vacuum admits both proton-protecting currents and currents that let the proton decay.
同一个真空，既容得下保护质子的电流，也容得下让质子衰变的电流。
And the windows fix only k over d squared: a second scale law is still missing.
三窗只钉住 k/d²：第二条尺度律仍然缺席。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Omega Unification, chapter thirteen.
《OMEGA 统一》· 第十三章
